subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Break sweat

options.text: To use a lot of energy or effort

solution:
The correct answer is **'To use a lot of energy or effort​'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"break sweat"** is best expressed by the alternative 3) *"To use a lot of energy or effort"*.(बहुत ऊर्जा या प्रयास उपयोग करना)
 
• **"Break sweat" **is an idiom used when someone is working very hard physically, to the point that they start to perspire or sweat.
 
• It can also be used metaphorically to refer to any situation requiring significant effort or hard work.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: *'To use a lot of energy or effort'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the meanings of all the alternatives in English and Hindi:
 
 
• **"To make a futile attempt"** - To try to do something that has no chance of success (व्यर्थ प्रयास करना).
 
• **"To lie"** - To say something that is not true (झूठ बोलना).
 
• **"To be caught stealing"** - To be discovered or found out while taking something dishonestly (चोरी करते हुए पकड़ा जाना).
